## Description {#details}

<p>An abstract state for querying live call edges.</p>


<p>This interface uses the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/attributor">Attributor</a>'s optimistic liveness information to compute the edges that are alive.</p>


<p>Definition at line 5494 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/transforms/include/llvm/transforms/ipo/attributor-h">Attributor.h</a>.</p>
